items.title: Web Accessibility Engineer
items.summary: Entry-level accessibility engineering role in Apple's central accessibility team in Hyderabad: evaluating web apps and recommending fixes.

items.title: Front End Web Accessibility Engineer, Retail Engineering
items.summary: Accessibility specialist for the Apple Online Store (WCAG 2.x, ARIA, React), with AI-assisted accessibility validation a plus.

items.title: ACM ASSETS 2026: 28th International SIGACCESS Conference on Computers and Accessibility
items.summary: ACM's flagship accessibility research conference, in Porto with virtual attendance; regular registration closes 24 October.

items.title: RESNA 2027 (at Abilities International): Student Design Challenge and Developers' Showcase
items.summary: RESNA's Student Design Challenge for assistive-technology projects, plus a Developers' Showcase for early-stage AT products, at its 2027 conference in New Jersey.

items.title: Zero Project Conference 2027 (#ZeroCon27)
items.location: Vienna, Austria (United Nations Office at Vienna)
items.summary: The Zero Project's annual conference on disability inclusion at the UN in Vienna; the 2027 themes include independent living and assistive technology.

items.title: Youth Entrepreneurs Challenge (YEC) 2027 - Accessibility theme
items.org: Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports (MY Bharat portal)
items.summary: Government youth-entrepreneur challenge with an Accessibility theme that covers assistive technology; prizes up to Rs 1.5 lakh for founders aged 18-35 with DPIIT or MSME registration. Confirm the closing date on the official page.
items.source: mybharat.gov.in YEC 2027 page; StartupGrantsIndia listing (for the close date)
